title: Companion App - Incorrect deltas / trend arrows and issues with the time it syncs
symptom: When using the Companion App source, xDrip shows incorrect deltas and trend arrows, and reading sync timing is off. For example, readings 1 minute apart can show a delta of +41 mg/dl instead of the expected +10, with the widget sometimes showing the correct delta but a wrong arrow while the app and notification show incorrect values.
cause: Navid (maintainer) states that for Companion App mode with a Dexcom device, the problem is 99% likely caused by Companion Bluetooth not being enabled. Another participant explains that xDrip reads notification data which may be stale, causing readings to sometimes be treated as only 1 minute apart and producing inflated deltas.
fix: Enable Companion Bluetooth as described at the xDrip docs for companion app mode with Dexcom devices. However, this is disputed in the thread and no confirmed resolution is given.
evidence_quote: If you are using the companion app mode with a Dexcom device and experience the problem described here, it is 99% likely you have not enabled Companion Bluetooth.
